name: epico
description: Scale-adaptive story framework for features and bugfixes: structured requirements (EARS), design, task breakdown, and execution with specialized sub-agents for codebase analysis, test authoring, review, implementation, and validation with audit.

defaultScale.title: Default scale
defaultScale.description: Default scale when triage cannot determine one (fast | standard | full | spike)

aiMemory.title: ai-memory integration
aiMemory.description: auto (default): detect the ai-memory MCP server with one local call at triage and, when it answers, recall prior knowledge at triage, prior deviations at run and prior audit findings at validate, and write deviation and audit pages. off: never call it. A server that is not there behaves like off, silently.

staleThresholdDays.title: Stale threshold (days)
staleThresholdDays.description: Days of inactivity before the story list flags a story with pending tasks as stale.

spikeStaleThresholdDays.title: Spike stale threshold (days)
spikeStaleThresholdDays.description: Days of inactivity before a spike whose Verdict is still open is flagged as stale. Separate from staleThresholdDays: a spike is measured by its Verdict, not by its checkboxes.

executorModel.title: Executor model
executorModel.description: inherit (default): the Executor runs on the session's model. haiku: every Executor spawn runs on Haiku — about a third cheaper, slower under a Sonnet session. by-complexity: Haiku for Trivial and Simple sub-tasks, the session's model for Moderate and High. Production code reaches an Executor only in a parallel group; everything that needs the session's context runs inline on the session's model.

reviewModel.title: Review model
reviewModel.description: The model of the verifying sub-agents, the Auditor and the Tech Reviewer. inherit (default): the session's model — on the same code a Sonnet review found 5 of 9 real defects where an Opus review found 8, for 22% less time. sonnet: faster, shallower. haiku: the fastest, for small stories.
